It depends on cargo, destination and aircraft availability. Charters have been arranged within days, and urgent scheduled shipments can often fly the same or next day.
Can you handle medicines and dangerous goods?
Yes. Medicines move in the right temperature range, and items such as oxygen cylinders, batteries or generators are declared and packed under IATA dangerous goods rules.
Many countries exempt genuine relief consignments, but the rules and paperwork differ. We coordinate with the receiving agency and our destination partners before the goods leave.
Can you collect from several suppliers?
Yes. We consolidate from multiple vendors across India, check quantities and labelling, and ship as one consignment or in waves.
